assessments.reasoning: The instrument does not contain questions satisfying any of the three elements. Regarding responsibility, Q7 mentions 'responsable de los quehaceres del hogar', but this is an activity status category rather than an explicit question about who is in charge of or organizes domestic tasks. Regarding performance, domestic and care work appear in Q14, Q6, Q7, Q13a, and Q60 as reasons for non-attendance at school, reasons for not seeking work, activity status, reasons for leaving a job, or reasons for not working more hours; per the indicator guidelines, activity status classifications, inactivity categories, and reasons for not working or seeking work do not count as asking whether a person carries out domestic or care tasks. Regarding magnitude, hours questions (Q28, Q29, Q29a) strictly record time devoted to employment/economic activities and do not record time or frequency spent on unpaid domestic or care work.
